scripts.dev: npm run build -w @psc/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w @psc/shared" "npm run dev -w @psc/server" "npm run dev -w @psc/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @psc/shared && npm run build -w @psc/server && npm run build -w @psc/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @psc/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @psc/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
